subject: Your framing workshop — a website concept for Framed Focus

body.content:
Hi Paul,

Your workshop’s wall of frame samples, signed Southampton shirt and artwork mounts show the range behind Framed Focus.

I’ve put the workshop first in this website concept, followed by complete framing examples, your services and direct enquiry links. Visitors can see the frames and mounts clearly, then choose how to get in touch about their own piece.

You can view it here:

https://summer-wind-dd7a.uumit-200ut-agents.workers.dev/

This is simply an independent concept for you to look at — I haven’t made any changes to your current business profiles.

If you like the concept but decide not to explore it further, an optional one-line reply about timing, price or missing value would help. I’m building this service independently and would appreciate your honest thoughts.

Eli\[REDACTED_EMAIL]
+86 182 6851 4405

If you’d prefer not to hear from me again, reply “unsubscribe” and I won’t contact you again.
